page.overview:
Who is Kuina Ubuyashiki?

Kuina was a girl with a pale skin complexion with a set of large, purple eyes. She wore a white blunt bob hair with fringe covering her forehead. She also adorned an elongated wisteria headpiece on the left side of her head.

Kuina was usually seen wearing a purple, flower-patterned Edo komon kimono with a white juban under it. She also wore a black obi with a white obiage under it and a pink obijime it.

Kuina displayed her strong sense of loyalty and devotion to her brother as the new head of the Ubuyashiki Family and leader of the Demon Slayer Corps by being the one to forcefully reminded him of his duties as their leader. She even resorted to physical force to remind him of this by slapping him, in order to ensure he did not break down under the stress of his responsibilities.

Kuina was born into the Ubuyashiki family as one of the quintuplets. She was one of the youngest children in the family.
